a_defect_this_wave_found_and_did_not_pap.what: The repository's own authority-route regression (check 14: 'no alternate shell executor in launcher/harness') FAILED when the new wave driver was first placed in the production launcher directory: it contained an absolute hasher path whose substring matched the control's shell-executor pattern.
a_defect_this_wave_found_and_did_not_pap.response: The control was NOT weakened, relaxed or exempted. The DRIVER was changed instead: it now spawns no external hashers at all, and cross-checks two externally-produced digests against its own independent re-hash of the provider bytes. The suite returned to 154/154 on the control's original terms.
a_defect_this_wave_found_and_did_not_pap.why_recorded: A green suite that was made green by editing the test is not evidence. The sequence is recorded so a reviewer can confirm which side moved.
